description: System maintenance capability for sweeping and pruning logs, stale workspaces, broken symlinks, and orphaned assets.
author: Charon Librarian

prune_orphaned_assets.description: Sweeps workspace directories for broken symlinks or unlinked assets.

datasheets_dir.description: Optional target directory for datasheets. Defaults to system configuration.

prune_stale_workspaces.description: Prunes stale task sandboxes and workspace artifacts.

prune_days.description: Number of days before a workspace is considered stale. Defaults to 7.

prune_logs_and_cache.description: Prunes old logs and cache files.

prune_days.description: Number of days before logs/cache are considered stale. Defaults to 7.
